title: Wardrobe list
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y9 lesson 30 (Pupil PDF worksheet: wardrobe list)
intro: Lesson 30: Items of clothing. To understand and use the Arabic words for everyday clothing

questions.q: Say what you are wearing today in one sentence.
questions.a: For example: أَلْبَسُ قَمِيصًا وَبِنْطَالًا وَجَوَارِبَ
questions.model: Teacher: أَلْبَسُ (I wear) + the items with ـًا: قَمِيصًا وَبِنْطَالًا. Note جَوَارِبَ (socks) has no tanwin.

questions.q: Wardrobe list on the pupil PDF: write ten items with harakat and هٰذَا / هٰذِهِ, then write three sentences: what you wear to school, to the masjid and at home. Start: أَلْبَسُ ...
questions.a: Ten items with correct demonstratives; three sentences with أَلْبَسُ and accusative endings
questions.model: Teacher writes: فِي المَسْجِدِ أَلْبَسُ ثَوْبًا أَبْيَضَ.

questions.q: ask a partner مَاذَا تَلْبَسُ فِي العِيدِ؟ and write the answer.
